profile.what: Monthly change in receipts at retail stores. Released 13:30 UK.
profile.why_gold: The cleanest read on whether the consumer - roughly 70% of the US economy - is still spending. Feeds growth expectations and therefore the rate path.

profile.name: FOMC Rate Decision
profile.what: The Federal Open Market Committee sets the target range for the federal funds rate. Announced at 19:00 UK (14:00 ET), followed 30 minutes later by the Chair's press conference.
profile.who: Federal Reserve, eight scheduled meetings a year
profile.why_gold: Gold pays no interest, so its opportunity cost is the real yield on cash and Treasuries. Anything that lowers expected real rates raises gold, and vice versa. This is the single most direct transmission channel there is.
profile.watch: The decision itself is usually priced in. The move comes from three other things: changes to the statement's language, the dot plot on projection meetings, and the tone of the press conference - which frequently reverses the initial statement reaction.
profile.gotchas: Two-leg event. Gold often moves one way on the 19:00 statement and the opposite way during the 19:30 presser. Judging the day on the first ten minutes is how people get caught.
profile.prior_move_usd: 20-60 on the day, more on projection meetings

profile.name: Summary of Economic Projections (dot plot)
profile.what: Every committee member's forecast for growth, unemployment, inflation and the appropriate policy rate. Published four times a year alongside the rate decision.
profile.who: Federal Reserve, March / June / September / December
profile.why_gold: The dot plot repriced the whole forward rate curve in one release. Gold trades the curve, not the current rate, so a shifted median dot moves it harder than the decision.
profile.watch: The median dot for the current and next year, and how many members moved. The longer-run dot matters for the real-rate anchor.
profile.gotchas: The dots are not a commitment and the Chair usually says so in the presser, which can unwind the initial move.

profile.name: FOMC Rate Decision
profile.what: The Federal Open Market Committee sets the target range for the federal funds rate. Announced at 19:00 UK (14:00 ET), followed 30 minutes later by the Chair's press conference.
profile.who: Federal Reserve, eight scheduled meetings a year
profile.why_gold: Gold pays no interest, so its opportunity cost is the real yield on cash and Treasuries. Anything that lowers expected real rates raises gold, and vice versa. This is the single most direct transmission channel there is.
profile.watch: The decision itself is usually priced in. The move comes from three other things: changes to the statement's language, the dot plot on projection meetings, and the tone of the press conference - which frequently reverses the initial statement reaction.
